name: Gorgias
verdict: Merchants install from the Gorgias App Store, and public apps must be approved by Gorgias's tech partnership team. Even a sandbox needs Gorgias to convert a trial; no published timeline, likely several weeks.
needGuide: Yes — register at partners.gorgias.com, fill in the Draft App form, and ask Gorgias to convert a trial into a sandbox.

auth.detail: OAuth2 authorization code is mandatory for public apps; private apps use API key basic auth (account email plus key). Per-merchant endpoints https://{subdomain}.gorgias.com/oauth/authorize and /oauth/token (HTTP Basic client auth). Access tokens last 24 h; refresh tokens do not currently expire and need the offline scope. PKCE not yet enabled; nonce and state are required.

effort.timeToFirstTest: 1-3 days (sandbox needs Gorgias to convert the trial)
effort.timeToProduction: unknown; likely several weeks (approval has no published SLA)

approval.gate: Merchants install from the in-product App Store (Settings → Integrations), which opens your App URL with an account parameter. Public apps must be approved by Gorgias's tech partnership team. No timeline is published. A sandbox account also requires a ready draft app and a manual conversion by Gorgias.

scopes.why: Many read/write scope pairs (tickets, customers, macros, rules…) to choose from; none documented as needing extra approval.
scopes.summary: openid, email, profile, offline plus read/write pairs: account, users, customers, tickets, custom_fields, events, integrations, jobs, macros, rules, satisfaction_survey, tags, apps; statistics:read. write:all is deprecated. No scope was documented as needing extra approval.

prerequisites: Account and owner: Developer Portal account plus a Gorgias trial converted to a developer account by techpartners@gorgias.com.
Where you register: Developer Portal (partners.gorgias.com) → create Draft App form → receive Client ID and Secret
Cost: Free; no partner fee found

registerAt.path: Developer Portal (partners.gorgias.com) → create Draft App form → receive Client ID and Secret

steps.do: Register at partners.gorgias.com/signup and start the Draft App form
Create a trial at gorgias.com/signup and email techpartners@gorgias.com with the account URL to get a developer account
Implement the App URL handler (reads account), authorize with state and nonce, exchange the code with Basic auth
Choose minimal scopes and include offline for refresh; handle 24 h access tokens
Test install and uninstall in the sandbox (the demo repo github.com/gorgias/appstore-demo-app helps)
Add screenshots, finish the Draft App form and click Submit Application
Respond to the review result and fix requested changes

roles.team: Developer Portal account plus a Gorgias trial converted to a developer account by techpartners@gorgias.com.
roles.customer: A merchant account user who clicks Connect App and accepts the consent page (admin requirement likely, not confirmed). Merchants can uninstall or revoke the refresh token.

testing: Register at partners.gorgias.com, create a Gorgias trial, then email techpartners@gorgias.com (with a draft app ready) to convert it to a developer account; sandbox starts as a Demo account and the plan switch is manual.

blockers.problem: Sandbox needs a draft app first and manual conversion by Gorgias
Users must start from the App Store
blockers.fix: Build your App URL handler to read the account subdomain.
Protect the client secret and use state and nonce.

automation.agentCan: Write the OAuth code and account-subdomain handling, draft the Draft App form, scope rationale and listing copy, and run test calls.
automation.humanMust: Register on the portal, email techpartners@gorgias.com, upload screenshots, submit the app, and respond to the tech partnership team.

uncertain: Review duration and criteria (Draft App form and quality-guidelines pages did not load); eligibility rules to submit; the merchant role required to install.
